title: Yellowed Syrian Hazelnut Pilaf
description: A fatty and fluffy Syrian dish featuring hazelnuts and a hint of chocolate, perfect for curing hangovers. This shojin-friendly pilaf is made with sashimi-cut ingredients and served on a slate-tile vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped hazelnuts and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the basmati rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the water, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the nutella.
Transfer the pilaf to a slate-tile vessel and garnish with chopped green onions.
Let the pilaf cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the pilaf in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
